title.ko: 면접 질문과 답변 · 강점과 약점 · 경력 설명 · 현재완료
title.en: interview questions and answers · strengths and weaknesses · describing experience · present perfect

explain.ko: 면접에서는 자신의 경력, 능력, 지원 동기를 구체적으로 말해야 합니다. 경력은 현재완료(I have worked … for five years)로, 구체적인 과거의 일은 과거형(I was responsible for …)으로 말합니다. 강점은 My strength is …, I am good at …, 약점은 My weakness is …, 하지만 개선 노력을 함께 말하면 좋습니다(I am working on it). 성과는 숫자와 함께 말하면 설득력이 높아집니다(doubled the number of clients). 마지막에는 Thank you for the opportunity로 마무리합니다.
explain.en: In an interview describe your experience, abilities and motivation in specific terms. Use the present perfect for experience up to now (I have worked … for five years) and the past simple for specific past events (I was responsible for …). Strengths: My strength is …, I am good at …. Weaknesses: My weakness is …, ideally with how you are improving (I am working on it). Figures make achievements persuasive (doubled the number of clients). Close with Thank you for the opportunity.

notes.en: Be honest about weaknesses and add how you improve.
Full sentences sound more polite in interviews.

prompt.ko: 면접에서 자기 경력, 강점, 약점, 지원 이유를 4문장으로 말해 보세요.
prompt.en: Write 4 sentences for an interview: experience, strength, weakness and reason for applying.

task.model: I have worked in the marketing team for five years. My strength is communication and my weakness is perfectionism. I was responsible for managing the team and dealing with customers. I applied because I want a bigger challenge in this company.

model_trans.ko: 저는 5년 동안 마케팅 팀에서 일해 왔습니다. 제 강점은 의사소통이고 약점은 지나친 완벽주의입니다. 저는 팀 관리와 고객 응대를 책임졌습니다. 이 회사에서 더 큰 도전을 하고 싶어 지원했습니다.
model_trans.en: I have worked in the marketing team for five years. My strength is communication and my weakness is perfectionism. I was responsible for managing the team and dealing with customers. I applied because I want a bigger challenge in this company.
